basis: Enteropathy, cholestasis, fractures and hearing impairment each occur in 4/4. Developmental delay in 2/4 omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: defining secretory enteropathy occurs in 4/4, with villous atrophy in 2/4.
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment occurs in 4/4; placed here because primary is capped at three axes.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment defines Down syndrome; congenital heart defects occur in ~40-50%. Common separately diagnosed thyroid, middle-ear and refractive disorders excluded.

decisions.ocular: none: common vision problems largely comprise separately diagnosed refractive errors and strabismus; direct ocular damage in >=30% is not established.
decisions.otologic: none: common hearing impairment largely reflects separately diagnosed middle-ear disease; direct intrinsic ear damage in >=30% is not established.

basis: Alloimmune red-cell destruction causes bilirubin brain injury; permanent auditory neuropathy/hearing loss is a major defining feature of chronic kernicterus.

decisions.otologic: involved: permanent auditory neuropathy/hearing loss is a major feature of chronic kernicterus, supporting inclusion independently of a prevalence estimate.

basis: Congenital ocular malformations define disease. Global developmental delay occurs in 1/1 assessed patient; supplied HPO frequency supports involvement, with substantial sampling uncertainty.

decisions.neurologic: involved: global developmental delay is reported in 1/1 assessed patient; use the supplied HPO frequency, while acknowledging the very small denominator.

basis: Parasitic infection with liver cysts or infiltration in ~60-75%. Pulmonary involvement is usually ~20-30%, insufficiently consistent across the umbrella for inclusion.

decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatic occupation occurs in ~60-75%; the umbrella infection permits several organ sites and is not defined specifically by hepatic disease.

basis: Hereditary motor-sensory axonal neuropathy; distal weakness, neurogenic wasting and foot deformities follow denervation rather than direct muscle or skeletal disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: weakness, wasting and associated foot deformities are downstream effects of neuropathy; direct musculoskeletal injury is not established.

basis: Pituitary deficiency and polydactyly define syndrome; developmental delay/seizures 2/2 and cleft palate 1/3. Urinary reflux 1/1 omitted at four-axis cap; samples small.

decisions.renal: none: vesicoureteral reflux is reported in 1/1; omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of defining endocrine/skeletal features, severe neurologic impairment and cleft palate.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: cleft palate occurs in 1/3, meeting ~30%; it is an intrinsic structural manifestation explicitly supported by the syndrome definition.

basis: Meningothelial neoplasm classified under tumors of meninges; parapharyngeal location alone does not establish pharyngeal airway invasion or dysfunction.

decisions.pulmonary: none: the parapharyngeal space is adjacent to the pharynx; airway occupation or damage is not established.
decisions.neurologic: primary: meningioma denotes meningothelial tumor origin, supported by the tumor-of-meninges ancestry, despite the ectopic location.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment and high myopia occur in 80-99%; muscle loss 80-99%, delayed fontanelle closure 100%. Dental caries 80-99% omitted at four-axis cap.

decisions.neurologic: involved: developmental impairment and cortical abnormalities occur in 80-99%; the supplied concept is defined primarily by inherited cutis laxa.

basis: Brainstem disease causes swallowing, laryngeal and autonomic dysfunction; direct gastrointestinal, airway or cardiac injury is not established.

decisions.pulmonary: none: abnormal laryngeal sensation and motility reflect impaired brainstem control; intrinsic airway damage is not established.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: swallowing dysfunction and reflux reflect impaired neural control; defining symptoms alone do not establish direct gastrointestinal damage.
